commission.source_quote: . The Platform shall retain a commission of twenty-eight percent (28%) of the Net Order Value.

delivery_fee.source_quote: . No delivery partner fee applies to this agreement.

hold.source_quote: . The Seller's share shall be settled following payment capture. Delivery confirmation is not a precondition to settlement.

promotion_funding.source_quote: . Discounts shall be funded 100% by the Platform.

provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC contract corpus — not a real merchant agreement.

refund.source_quote: . Where a refund is issued the Seller payout shall first be reversed. Commission is refundable.

tax.source_quote: . The Platform shall withhold tax at source at one percent (1%) of the commission amount.
